summary.tldr: Adds used motor vehicles to the Excise Tax Act list of zero-rated supplies.
what_it_does: Adds used motor vehicles, including motor homes, that were registered to a different owner under provincial law, to the list of zero-rated supplies under the Excise Tax Act.
Excludes new vehicles that were first registered to a dealer for the purpose of the first sale from this used-vehicle rule.
summary.background: It changes Schedule VI to the Excise Tax Act. Zero-rated supplies are taxed at 0%.
